paragraphs.text: # Oh My DSH
简体中文

Oh My DSH is an independent, community-maintained experimental project for
organizing versioned comp

onent sets and defaults in a clear, reviewable, and
reproducible form.

This public repository candidate is an early preview. It currently contains

ublicly for this project, explicitly fictional test

- `schemas/distribution-v1.schema.j

son`

- `test/fixtures/` — fictional data used only by tests.
- `scripts/

ied Chinese CLI messages.
